paragraph: [On 12 June 2026 Angola Cables launched GO4AI at ANGOTIC 2026 in Luanda](<https://forbesafricalusofona.com/angola-cables-lanca-plataforma-de-ia-e-aposta-na-soberania-digital-do-pais/>), a self-service marketplace for AI training and inference with on-demand NVIDIA GPUs, billed in local currency. [In February 2026 AGT said it is building its own in-house AI system](<https://correiokianda.info/inteligencia-artificial-coloca-incumpridores-sob-analise-reforcada-da-agt/>), with machine-learning tests since 2024. Both date from the last twelve months. GO4AI runs on Angola Cables' global infrastructure, and its GPUs are not placed in Angola. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service in the country. Operating would need a facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators in service in the country.

In February 2026 Burundian company Hyphen Tech's [AgriHyphen app was in use by farmers](<https://www.globalsouthworld.com/article/ai-app-helps-burundian-farmers-detect-crop-diseases-early-video>). Its tool recognises 37 diseases across seven crops. In the last twelve months, in September 2026 the Ijwi ry'Ikirundi AI project [published a free Kirundi dataset of 1,813 sentences](<https://github.com/Ijwi-ry-Ikirundi-AI/Kirundi_Dataset>). In 2025 the AI4Mpox Burundi team [developed a machine-learning-ready epidemiological dataset](<https://www.ai4d.ai/fr/innovations/ai-powered-surveillance-and-response-network>). No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

[GPT.BJ, a chatbot built by the Benin Agency for Information Systems and Digital (ASIN), was launched in 2023](<https://council.science/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/AI-Paper-Case-Study-Benin_V1.pdf>). It answers questions on the tax, digital, labour and penal codes. In the last twelve months, [on 18 November 2026 the minister announced that the J'aime ma langue project is open source](<https://iconiqafrique.com/en/ia/benin-ia-jaime-ma-langue-open-source/>), with 1,000 hours of language data in Fon, Dendi, Bariba and Yoruba. [In November 2026 the Council of Ministers approved a pilot in which Innobox hubs collect datasets in national languages](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0511-60528-benin-plans-digital-fabrication-hubs-to-boost-local-innovation>). No source found says AI computing is in service in the country. Operating would need a facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators in service in the country.

On 15 October 2026 the CITADEL centre and the Data Lab [launched L'Essentiel.bf](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article149991>), a free platform that uses AI to summarise national news in French and Mooré as text and audio. On 2 November 2026 Sahal Tech and Old Rock Group [agreed to build an African language data platform](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/11/06/burkina-fasos-sahal-tech-partners-with-old-rock-group-to-develop-african-language-ai/>), starting with Mooré, Dioula, Fulfulde and Bambara. In July 2026 TIC Magazine BF reported that CITADEL had [built a French-Mooré voice and text translator](<https://ticmagazine.bf/intelligence-artificielle-burkina-faso-2026/>). All three date from the last twelve months. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service. Operating would need such a facility in service in the country.

[In February 2025 the Guardian Sun reported that two Batswana, Kitso Speaks and Glen Mokoka, built a Setswana AI](<https://guardiansun.co.bw/news/speaks-mokoka-the-brains-behind-setswana-artificial-intelligence/news>), trained on a dataset they collected. The work is self-funded. In the last twelve months, there were [In August 2026 NGARi said it is building a Setswana AI commons at the Botswana University of Agriculture and Natural Resources](<https://blog.ngari.ai/p/botswana>). It has scoped a US$27,000 offline GPU kit, not yet installed, for 2027. [In November 2026 Amini said it was digitising the minerals ministry's geological records with its Soma model](<https://techcabal.com/2026/11/25/amini-africa-paper-archives-data-ai/>). No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service in the country. Operating would need such a facility in service.

In May 2026 MEYNG, founded by Michel Wenezoui, said its [SangoAI translation system for Sango is in production](<https://huggingface.co/blog/MEYNG/sangoai>). In 2026 it [openly released a Sango-French translation model on Hugging Face](<https://huggingface.co/MEYNG/nllb-sango-finetuned-600m>). Institut Pasteur de Bangui says its MEDICINE project [will develop AI diagnostic aid tools for fever in under-fives](<https://www.afrique-sur7.fr/diagnostic-de-la-fievre-infantile-lintelligence-artificielle-descend-dans-larene-en-centrafrique>). The project runs four years from August 2024. In the last twelve months, MEYNG made its May 2026 statement and released its model. No source found says where SangoAI was built, and no GPU facility has been found. Establishing would need a released AI model built in the country, a published AI dataset, or AI computing in service.

On 18 May 2026 Minister Djibril Ouattara [said Cote d'Ivoire has begun work on an Ivorian artificial intelligence](<https://www.lintelligentdabidjan.info/news/protection-des-donnees-personnelles-la-cote-divoire-prepare-son-cadre-sur-lintelligence-artificielle/>). In August 2026 the AfDB's deputy director for West Africa [said it will equip the country with AI infrastructure, including high-performance computing and GPUs](<https://digitalmag.ci/services-publics-financements-bad-des-projets-numeriques-en-cote-divoire-appels-doffres-et-avis-a-manifestation-dinteret/>). In the last twelve months, FuturAfric's YIRI project [launched its platform in Abidjan in October 2026](<https://www.linfodrome.com/societe/126771-intelligence-artificielle-la-plateforme-yiri-entend-faciliter-l-acces-au-numerique-grace-aux-langues-locales>). It had [run a national campaign in 2025 to collect voice and image data in Ivorian languages](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-yiri-quand-le-numerique-parle-les-langues-locales/>). No source found since October 2023 says a model is released, a dataset published, or AI computing in service. Establishing would need a released AI model built in the country, a published AI dataset, or AI computing in service.

In July 2025 the Direction Generale du Budget said [GOV-AI runs only on local servers, on CENADI's national infrastructure](<https://www.dgb.cm/gov-ai-lintelligence-artificielle-gouvernementale-en-vitrine-au-sago-2025/>). It is available through the nGomna app. Researchers at the universities of Ngaoundere and Dschang and ESSCA [built a machine-learning tax fraud model](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/2708-16627-cameroon-built-ai-claims-97-2-precision-in-tax-fraud-detection-but-revenue-impact-remains-unclear>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026 it was reported trained on 3.2 million records and piloted at three tax centres. In February 2025 ST Digital [announced GPU Cloud Africa](<https://itweb.africa/content/mYZRXv9g4nEMOgA8>), with NVIDIA GPU servers to be deployed in Douala. No GPU facility in service has been found since October 2023. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

In April 2025 the Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship [said it developed Snote Manager, grading software that uses AI](<https://edu-nc.gouv.cd/news/artificial-intelligence-at-the-heart-of-state-exam-correction>). In the last twelve months, on 27 June 2026 Université Nouveaux Horizons [inaugurated the Lofoyi supercomputer in Lubumbashi](<https://www.unhorizons.org/inauguration-lofoyi-premier-supercalculateur-academique-rdc/>). The university describes it as optimised for AI, with 150 TFLOPS. On 6 August 2026 the Ministry of Digital Economy [launched a project to collect Lingala language data](<https://acp.cd/economie/rdc-la-campagne-de-vulgarisation-du-code-du-numerique-lancee-a-kinshasa/>). No source found since October 2023 names GPUs or other AI accelerators in the country. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

In 2026 Congo Digital Services, working with UNDP and the digital ministry, published [an 884-pair Lingala image-text dataset](<https://huggingface.co/datasets/Congo-digital-service/dataset-qwen-vl-lingala-qlora-vf>). It also published [the weights of a Lingala-tuned Llama 3.1 8B model](<https://huggingface.co/Congo-digital-service/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Lingala-QLoRA-merged-v2>). In the last twelve months, the AI strategy technical committee [was launched on 6 May 2026](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/intelligence-artificielle-et-langues-nationales-le-congo-lance-les-travaux-de-sa-strategie>) to produce a digital corpus for Lingala and Kituba. RFI reported in November 2025 that [a data centre in Brazzaville was being finished](<https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/afrique-%C3%A9conomie/20251119-le-congo-brazzaville-s-%C3%A9quipe-d-un-data-center-pour-r%C3%A9pondre-au-d%C3%A9fi-des-infrastructures-de-l-ia>). No source found since October 2023 says a facility with GPUs or AI accelerators is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

On 28 July 2026 a Comorian graduate [launched Komori TTS, the first Shikomori text-to-speech application](<https://alwatwan.net/societe/intelligence-artificielle-i-«komori-tts-»,-la-première-synthèse-vocale-dédiée-au-shikomori.html>). In 2026 Komor-IA [released a French-Shikomori parallel dataset of 1,424 sentence pairs](<https://huggingface.co/datasets/Komor-IA/French-ShiKomori-Parallel-Dataset>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026 a CNDRS researcher [presented two AI early-warning models for Comorian conditions](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/l%E2%80%99intelligence-artificielle-aux-comores-mariama-madi-%C3%A9veille-les-consciences-%C3%A0-lamerican-corner-.html>). Both were simulated on real data and not deployed. No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

On 19 November 2024 Cabo Verde [launched an AI application for financial and accounting management](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/-/vice-primeiro-ministro-destaca-transforma%C3%A7%C3%A3o-digital-como-pilar-do-desenvolvimento-de-cabo-verde>). NOSi developed it with the national company SINTAXY. In April 2025 Uni-CV researcher Mateus Andrade [presented acoustic AI models in Creole for health applications](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/eitec/2025/04/19/uni-cv-com-ciclo-de-palestras-sobre-inteligencia-artificial-e-quimica-computacional/96651>). In the last twelve months, in 2026 the University of Cabo Verde was [building AI and IoT water-management systems in the SSWAxC4V project](<https://www.unicv.edu.cv/pt/nots-geral/5824-unico-projeto-arise-em-cabo-verde-apresenta-resultados-a-african-academy-of-sciences>). No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

In September 2026 HOOM, an AI-based education application developed by Djiboutians, [was used by more than 4,500 terminale pupils](<https://www.lanation.dj/intelligence-artificielle-les-acteurs-dun-ecosysteme-en-construction/>). Djibouti Ports Corridor Road [developed CorridorVision AI, a road-defect detection model](<https://dpcr.dj/2026/01/15/corridorvision-ai-ai-powered-road-condition-monitoring-for-djiboutis-trade-corridors/>). It [was launched in 2024 as DPCR Vision AI](<https://www.dawan.africa/news/djibouti-unveils-ai-tools-to-modernize-ports-and-logistics>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026 the labour minister [met LinkWise on the planned AI compute infrastructure](<https://www.adi.dj/public/article/139002>). No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

In the last twelve months, in September 2026 [a draft decree creating a national research centre for AI and data went forward for legal review](<https://dzwatch.dz/?p=79285>). On 21 September 2026 the higher education ministry's commission [reported four large language models](<https://www.mesrs.dz/fr/2026/09/le-ministre-de-lenseignement-superieur-et-de-la-recherche-scientifique-preside-la-troisieme-reunion-multisectorielle-consacree-au-suivi-de-la-mise-en-oeuvre-de-la-strategie-nationale-de-l/>). Two were completed and two in development. On 9 November 2026 the minister [discussed an AI data centre with a Chinese delegation](<https://www.mesrs.dz/en/2026/11/minister-of-higher-education-and-scientific-research-discusses-with-chinese-delegation-the-project-to-establish-an-artificial-intelligence-data-centre-at-the-national-higher-school-of-artificial-intel/>), at the national AI school. No source found since October 2023 says a model is released, a dataset published, or AI computing in service. Establishing would need a released AI model built in the country, a published AI dataset, or AI computing in service.

[The ministry's Applied Innovation Center built AI applications including the Karnak language model, Loghat and Bel Masry, the minister said](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/25/egypt-ai-council-national-ai-strategy-quantum-computing/>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 Vodacom's technology chief said ground had been broken on Africa Data Centres Egypt](<https://www.businessday.co.za/companies/2026-10-18-vodacoms-technology-chief-outlines-regional-data-centre-strategy/>), which will run its own GPUs. [In November 2026 Vodacom's chief executive put its cost at about US$1 billion](<https://techcentral.co.za/vodacom-ai-data-centre-hubs-south-africa-kenya-egypt/288232/>). On 14 November 2026 the Public Prosecution [opened its own AI data centre](<https://arqam.news/610073/>), described without GPUs. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service. Operating would need a facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators in service in the country.

GeezLab's GLaRe programme [lists open Tigrinya datasets](<https://research.geezlab.com/>). They include the TiNC24 named-entity corpus of more than 200,000 words and the TiPOSC24 part-of-speech corpus of more than 118,000 tokens. Students at Mai Nefhi College of Engineering led both. The programme lists Dahlak LMs, a family of language models for Eritrean languages, as in progress. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a facility with GPUs or AI accelerators is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

The Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute, UNDP and Addis Ababa University [opened the AI UniPod on 16 February 2026](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9899270>). On 9 November 2026 a UNDP regional director said UNDP's EDGE initiative provides high-performance GPUs there. That day 51 AI startup founders from 12 African countries began a 10-day residency. In the last twelve months, in October 2026 a WHO delegation [reviewed the institute's speech-to-text, translation and disease-model tools](<https://www.afro.who.int/countries/ethiopia/news/who-and-ethiopian-artificial-intelligence-institute-explore-strategic-collaboration-advance-ai>). No source found gives the number of the AI UniPod's GPUs. None counts its users beyond the November 2026 residency.

The Gabonese Scientific Committee for AI Research met the Economic, Social, Environmental and Cultural Council on 7 July 2026. It presented [its work on Obone AI](<https://www.csgria.ga/actualites/article/le-csgr-ia-recu-en-audience/>). The committee calls it the first Gabonese AI system able to process and answer in Fang, and it is still in development. In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the chief technology officer of ST Digital said its Nkok data centre will also host computing for sovereign AI](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/jean-francis-ahanda-la-souverainete-numerique-ne-se-decrete-pas-elle-se-construit-avec-letat/>). No GPUs or date were given. No released model, dataset or AI computing in service has been found. Establishing would need a Gabonese AI model released, a dataset made for AI published, or AI computing in service.

[Accra-based MinoHealth AI Labs built the Moremi Bio model, which has proposed hundreds of drug candidates](<https://restofworld.org/2026/ghana-ai-lab-minohealth-bioweapons-threat-dna-synthesis-regulation/>). In the last twelve months, [in April 2026 the research institute CSIR-INSTI released its own AI apps for crop disease and malaria detection](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/ghana-news-artificial-intelligence-tools-rolled-out-to-support-agricultural-healthcare-services.html>). [In October 2026 the minister said a national data centre and computing infrastructure was in procurement](<https://www.citinewsroom.com/2026/10/phase-one-of-ghanas-first-data-centre-to-be-ready-in-24-months-sam-george/>), with a first phase due within 24 months. [The 2027 Budget, presented on 12 November 2026, allocates US$300 million over 2027 and 2028 for a National AI Centre](<https://www.citinewsroom.com/2026/11/ghanas-250m-ai-centre-to-focus-on-practical-applications-not-rival-us-china-ato-forson/>). No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service. Operating would need a facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators in service in the country.

In September 2026 the Guinean startup 224 N'Lambé [said it offers translation APIs between French and Pular, Malinké and Soussou](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/ahmed-conscient-bald%C3%A9-655b85177_224-nlamb%C3%A9-api-linfrastructure-linguistique-activity-7503887516295430145-kypq>). In March 2024 a five-person Guinean team's Nma Xui, a Pular and Soso translation prototype, [was at an early stage](<https://afrique.le360.ma/societe/guinee-les-langues-locales-se-mettent-a-lia_KM4QTYOVL5FMLFD4L4KR4EWNEE/>). In the last twelve months, the September 2026 offer is the latest step found. In April 2025 the minister said the [science and innovation policy provides for AI laboratories and a sovereign data centre](<https://lelynx.net/2025/05/cite-des-sciences-de-guinee-une-conference-autour-de-lintelligence-artificielle/>). No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

In April 2026 Jollof Lab [released an open-source Mandinka-English translation model on HuggingFace](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/sheikh-tijan-cham-000966197_nlp-machinetranslation-mandinka-activity-7448293716806586368-q-iI>). It was fine-tuned from NLLB-200 on 5,797 sentence pairs. In the last twelve months, in May 2026 LingoAI and Jokkolabs Banjul [signed a three-year MoU to create curated Mandinka, Wolof and Fula datasets for AI](<https://lingoai.io/blog/cmshc4wo600009kgnfjhb3q5u>). No source found says where Jollof Lab built its model. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found. Establishing would need a released AI model built in the country, a published AI dataset, or AI computing in service.

[In April 2025 Rowe, Gow-Smith and Hepple introduced a machine translation dataset for Guinea-Bissau Creole (Kiriol)](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.02674>), with around 40 thousand parallel sentences with English and Portuguese. The authors trained transformer models on it. In 2026, [the OKINKA site presented a national AI assistant in service in Portuguese, Kriol, French, Balanta, Fula and Mandinka](<https://guineia.com/>). The site says the state owns it and that it was developed with Estonia's Goldenseal Group. No source gives a date within the last twelve months beyond the year 2026. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service in the country. Operating would need such a facility in service.

In March 2026 Servernah Cloud [launched at iXAfrica's NBOX1 data centre in Nairobi with GPU capacity for AI](<https://atlancis.com/servernah-cloud-launch/>). In November 2025 Atlancis Technologies said it had [deployed an NVIDIA GPU AI factory there](<https://atlancis.com/atlancis-technologies-ai-infra/>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026 the Judiciary [was piloting Mahakama AI, a legal research tool it built in-house](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2026-11-19-judiciary-pilots-ai-tool-to-tackle-case-backlog>). Servernah Cloud is offered commercially, and no customer of it is named. No source found since October 2023 names or counts users of national AI computing, models or datasets. Mature would need national AI computing, models or datasets open to named or counted users.

[On 31 July 2026 Liblaw, Liberia's largest digital law library, launched the AI legal assistant CJ Lewis](<https://fpa.news/liberia-launches-first-legal-learning-artificial-intelligence-cj-lewis-to-expand-public-access-to-the-law/>), built on its platform of Supreme Court opinions from 1861 to 2026, statutes and regulations. [In July 2026 a Central Bank of Liberia employee was reported to have invented an AI system for macroeconomic forecasting](<https://fpa.news/undp-reaffirms-commitment-to-liberias-digital-transformation-at-tech-summit/>), and the bank is using it. [In April 2026 Palava Innovations listed on the finance ministry's dashboard an AI health platform](<https://development.mfdp.gov.lr/activities/2396>) in implementation until the end of 2026. All three date from the last twelve months. No GPU or AI-accelerator facility has been found in service. Operating would need a facility with GPUs or other AI accelerators in service in the country.

In October 2025 the Libya Herald [reported the announcement in Tripoli of LIBIGPT, the first generative AI model in Libya](<https://libyaherald.com/2025/10/libyas-first-ai-system-libigpt-launched-in-presence-of-minister-of-economy-and-trade>). Smart Co for Technology Projects and Artificial Intelligence implemented it. In the last twelve months, in 2026 the Audit Bureau head said [Diwan Bot, an institutional AI model, was designed and developed entirely by young national talent](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=358534&lang=en>). The National Authority for Information Security and Safety [built the Nissa AI assistant on Google's open Gemma 3 model](<https://informatics.ly/en/session/ai-and-emerging-technologies-governance-session/>). No source found since October 2023 says a facility with GPUs or AI accelerators is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

[SeSoDa, a dataset of 1,966 Lesotho Sesotho-English prompt-completion pairs, was published open source in 2025 with a baseline model](<https://doi.org/10.55492/v6i02.6742>). In the last twelve months, [the Government of Lesotho launched the Kobong hydropower and AI data-centre project on 31 July 2026](<https://www.gov.ls/energy/record-breaking-m100-billion-investment-secured-for-lesothos-hydropower-and-artificial-intelligence-data-centre/>). [In October 2026 the ICT minister said the government was upgrading high-performance computing at the Mohale's Hoek Data Centre](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91936>). [In November 2026 Minister Moorosi said Phase One of the National Compute Roadmap is under way](<https://pp.itu.int/2026/en/itu_policy_statements/lesotho-2/>). No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found in service. Operating would need such a facility in service in the country.

In September 2026 the digital ministry and Mistral AI [released in open source a classifier for Arabic dialects and a Darija speech model](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7504/morocco-mistral-ai-release-first-open-source-ai-tools-under-ai-made-in-morocco-r>). LesEco says the [Sovereign Meeting Assistant was trained on Moroccan GPUs](<https://leseco.ma/maroc/maroc-ia-2030-le-royaume-passe-de-lambition-a-laction.html>). In the last twelve months, [on 25 November 2026 the president of Nexus Core Systems announced the start of construction of an AI computing platform at Nouaceur](<https://telquel.ma/instant-t/2026/11/25/nexus-core-systems-annonce-le-debut-des-travaux-de-sa-plateforme-dia_2019760/>). AtlasIA put [its Darija dataset on Hugging Face](<https://www.atlasia.ma/blog/al-atlas-pretraining>). No source found says national AI computing, models or datasets are open to named or counted users. Mature would need them open to researchers, startups or other countries, with users named or counted.

In 2025 LIAM, the Madagascar AI laboratory, [said its project is to develop a Malagasy-language large language model](<https://liam-ai.org/projets/grand-modele-de-langage-malgache/>). The model is to be accessible through an API. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a model is released, a dataset published, or AI computing in service. No facility with GPUs or AI accelerators has been found. Establishing would need a released AI model built in the country, a published AI dataset, or AI computing in service.

In November 2025 RobotsMali AI4D Lab in Bamako [released 612 hours of transcribed Bambara speech and fine-tuned speech-recognition models](<https://robotsmali.org/en/african-next-voices-robotsmali-releases-major-bambara-dataset-models-research-tools/>). They are deployed in the An Be Kalan app. In the last twelve months, in October 2026 Tidiani Togola said RobotsMali and the MALIBA-AI community [had gathered hundreds of hours of Bambara recordings](<https://amap.ml/2026/10/23/intelligence-artificielle-et-souverainete-numerique-le-mali-face-aux-defis-de-la-gouvernance-et-de-la-desinformation/>). In May 2025 the AI and robotics centre near Kati [was still unfinished](<https://benbere.org/au-grin/intelligence-artificielle-mali-est-aujourdhui/>). No source found since October 2023 says a GPU or AI-accelerator facility is in service. Operating would need a GPU or AI-accelerator facility in service in the country.

On 22 October 2026 MAZA IA, an AI learning tool developed by MOZEDUCA with Vodacom Moçambique, [was launched with the education minister](<https://mznews.co.mz/governo-prepara-lei-para-regular-uso-da-inteligencia-artificial-na-educacao/>).
